name: payment-platform

scripts.db:up: echo Using local Postgres - make sure the service is running and the payment_platform database exists (see README)
scripts.db:down: echo Using local Postgres - stop it via your OS service manager, not this script
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm smoke && pnpm check:erasure

pnpmComment: overrides.fastify: Fastify plugins augment the FastifyInstance type. Multiple copies of fastify in the tree means those augmentations land on different type identities and plugin registration fails to type-check. Pin one copy.
